---
description: "Use when creating or updating Markdown documentation, READMEs, runbooks, or changelogs."
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Markdown instructions

- Begin with a descriptive title and short purpose statement.
- Include prerequisites, numbered procedures, examples, expected results, troubleshooting, limitations, and references when relevant; omit empty boilerplate.
- Use language-labeled code fences, descriptive links, and useful image descriptions. Keep examples safe and accurate, and never expose credentials or invent test results.
- Update documentation when behavior changes. A separate changelog is optional unless the project requires one.

The maintained reference is [CodeStandards](https://github.com/gwblok/CodeStandards).
